tiers.title: Work
tiers.summary: What people and agents are here to do.

tiers.title: The agent loop
tiers.summary: An agent works, a person accepts. What makes Taff different.

tiers.title: Control and trust
tiers.summary: Who may act, and proof of what happened.

tiers.title: Time and money on work
tiers.summary: Attributes of work: when, in what order, for how much.

tiers.title: Context
tiers.summary: Enriches work. Work survives without it.

tiers.title: Views, not things
tiers.summary: Recomputed on read. Nothing is stored.

things.title: System
things.summary: One installation of Taff. Holds users and organizations.

things.title: User
things.summary: A person who can sign in. May carry the system administrator flag.

things.title: Group of organizations
things.summary: Not modelled. Nothing groups several organizations.

things.title: Organization
things.summary: Called workspace in code. The boundary of data and permission.

things.title: Member
things.summary: A user or an agent inside one organization, with one role there.

things.title: Agent
things.summary: A member of kind agent, with a supervisor and a review policy.

things.title: Project
things.summary: Flat. Stage, person in charge, saved progress, client company.

things.title: Sub-project or phase
things.summary: Not modelled. A project has no parent and no children.

things.title: Task
things.summary: A unit of work with an owner and an optional worker. May sit directly in the organization.

things.title: Subtask
things.summary: A task whose parent is another task.

things.title: Comment
things.summary: What someone said on a task.

things.title: Run
things.summary: One attempt by an agent to do a task.

things.title: Run event
things.summary: A step the agent took, with its cost and duration.

things.title: Deliverable
things.summary: What the run produced, kept for review.

things.title: Review decision
things.summary: A person's approval or request for changes, with the checklist.

things.title: Permission request
things.summary: An agent asks to use a capability; a person allows or denies it.

things.title: Suggestion
things.summary: A change an agent proposes; a person applies or undoes it.

things.title: Organization role
things.summary: Admin, member or guest. The first input of every permission check.

things.title: Capability
things.summary: What an agent may do: allow, ask or deny, per kind of action.

things.title: Token
things.summary: How an outside client acts as an agent, with scopes per organization.

things.title: Tool call
things.summary: One MCP call and how it ended.

things.title: Audit record
things.summary: Who did what to which thing. Also drives live refresh.

things.title: Due date
things.summary: The deadline, an instant.

things.title: Scheduled block
things.summary: A time block on the calendar, with optional repeat.

things.title: Plan
things.summary: A start day and a number of days. The bar on the Gantt.

things.title: Dependency
things.summary: This cannot start or finish before that.

things.title: Milestone
things.summary: A named date on a project.

things.title: Contract
things.summary: The agreed amount and currency.

things.title: Payment
things.summary: Money received. Append-only.

things.title: Company
things.summary: A client or partner.

things.title: Contact
things.summary: A person outside the organization.

things.title: Stakeholder role
things.summary: What a contact is to a company, a project or a task.

things.title: Mind-map node
things.summary: An idea on the mind map, with links to others.

things.title: Evidence source
things.summary: Where a mind-map node's claim comes from.

things.title: Label
things.summary: Free tags on a task. Six of them name the sectors.

things.title: Inbox item
things.summary: Something that needs a person: a mention, a blocked agent, a review.

things.title: Notification setting
things.summary: What a person wants to be told, and when.

things.title: Daily digest
things.summary: A person's own daily summary.

things.title: Audience
things.summary: Which recipients get the summary of which projects.

things.title: Shareholder summary
things.summary: A stored snapshot of project progress, as text and image.

things.title: Share link
things.summary: An expiring link to one summary.

things.title: Exported image
things.summary: A watermarked PNG of a view. Not stored; each export is audited.

things.title: Board, list and Today
things.summary: The same tasks, sorted and filtered.

things.title: Gantt model
things.summary: Spans, critical path, forecast and risk, computed from plans and dependencies.

things.title: Task completion and risk
things.summary: Progress computed from leaf tasks; the project's risk level.

things.title: Relations graph
things.summary: People, agents, tasks, projects, companies and contacts as one graph.

things.title: Sectors
things.summary: Tasks regrouped by six labels.

things.title: AI brief
things.summary: A daily reading of risk, finance and what needs a person.

rolesAt.title: System administrator
rolesAt.summary: A flag on the user. Admin membership in every organization.

rolesAt.title: Admin, member or guest
rolesAt.summary: One role per person per organization.

rolesAt.title: Owner
rolesAt.summary: A person. Edits, assigns, plans and approves.

rolesAt.title: Worker
rolesAt.summary: A person or an agent. Does the work; cannot mark it done.

rolesAt.title: Supervisor
rolesAt.summary: Approves the agent's work and decides its requests.

rolesAt.title: Stakeholder
rolesAt.summary: An outside person with a named role on the project.

roles.title: Admin
roles.summary: Everything in the organization: members, projects, finance, tokens, agents, summaries, audit.

roles.title: Member
roles.summary: Reads tasks, projects, finance and contacts. Creates tasks and comments. Edits what they own.

roles.title: Guest
roles.summary: Reads tasks, the relations graph and the mind map. No finance, no contacts, no writing.

roles.title: Agent
roles.summary: A member of kind agent. Limited by token scopes, its capabilities and temporary grants; finished work waits for a person.

modules.title: Tasks
modules.summary: Create, edit, assign, comment and change status; subtasks; labels; Quick Add; search; Today.

modules.title: Projects and finance
modules.summary: Project profile, stage, person in charge, contract amount and payments.

modules.title: Planning (Gantt)
modules.summary: Start and duration per task, milestones and dependencies. Computes the critical path, forecast and project risk on read.

modules.title: Calendar
modules.summary: Time blocks for tasks, with recurrence, and the unscheduled tray.

modules.title: Agents, runs and review
modules.summary: An agent works a task as a run, records events and deliverables, and waits for a person to approve.

modules.title: Access: tokens, OAuth and MCP
modules.summary: How an outside agent connects: OAuth approval, token scopes per organization, the permission function and the call log.

modules.title: Inbox and notifications
modules.summary: Mentions, blocked agents and reviews; preferences; the personal daily digest.

modules.title: AI brief, Ask and suggestions
modules.summary: Rule-based daily brief and answers, an optional model path per organization, and suggestions a person applies or undoes.

modules.title: Shareholder summaries
modules.summary: A daily project summary per audience, as text and image, with expiring share links.

modules.title: Exported view images
modules.summary: Project, timeline, week, month, mind and relations as a watermarked PNG. Images are not stored.

modules.title: Companies and contacts
modules.summary: Client and partner companies, people, and their roles on a company, project or task.

modules.title: Relations graph
modules.summary: One picture of people, agents, tasks, projects, companies and contacts. A read model that stores nothing.

modules.title: Mind map
modules.summary: Layered nodes with evidence sources; a node can link to a task.

modules.title: Sectors (operation template)
modules.summary: Regroups tasks by six sector labels. A view over task labels; nothing is stored.

modules.title: Organizations and members
modules.summary: Create, archive and restore an organization; invite people; set roles; the login default.

modules.title: Sign-in and profile
modules.summary: Email, username, phone and SMS sign-in; locale and time zone.

modules.title: Audit and realtime
modules.summary: Every write records who did what; a database notification tells open browsers what to refresh.

modules.title: Kernel
modules.summary: createCore wires every module and still holds the task, member and organization operations. Also migrations, seeds and health.

flows.title: A person hands work to an agent and approves it

steps.title: Task
steps.text: A person creates a task and sets an agent as worker.

steps.title: Run
steps.text: The agent starts a run; events and deliverables are recorded.

steps.title: Permission
steps.text: Each step is checked against scopes and capabilities. An “ask” capability pauses the run.

steps.title: Inbox
steps.text: The request, and later the finished work, reach the supervisor's inbox.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: The owner or supervisor approves or asks for changes in the review workspace.

steps.title: Done
steps.text: Only a person moves the task to done.

flows.title: A plan becomes a risk line and a report

steps.title: Tasks
steps.text: Status, due dates and subtasks.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Start, duration, milestones and dependencies; the model computes critical path, forecast and risk.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: The AI brief reports risk and finance per project.

steps.title: Summary
steps.text: The shareholder summary reuses the same model.

steps.title: Image
steps.text: The timeline exports as a watermarked PNG.

steps.title: Project
steps.text: Progress, stage, contract and payments are kept on the project.

steps.title: Audience
steps.text: An admin creates an audience tag, adds recipients and tags projects.

steps.title: Snapshot
steps.text: At each recipient's delivery time the worker stores a snapshot with a content hash.

steps.title: Render
steps.text: Text in core, PNG from the Rust renderer, both watermarked.

steps.title: Read
steps.text: The recipient signs in to read it, or an admin shares an expiring link.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: The agent's client opens the OAuth flow at /mcp.

steps.title: Role cap
steps.text: An admin approves scopes, never above their own role in that organization.

steps.title: Token
steps.text: The token is tied to one agent member, with grants per organization.

steps.title: Call
steps.text: Each tool call runs as that member through the same rules as a person.

steps.title: Record
steps.text: The call is logged and the write is audited.

flows.title: A change appears on another screen

steps.title: Write
steps.text: REST or MCP calls core inside one transaction.

steps.title: Core
steps.text: The mutation helper applies the rule and the version check.

steps.title: Audit
steps.text: A trigger writes the activity row and sends a notification with ids only.

steps.title: Socket
steps.text: The API forwards it to that organization's open browsers, which refetch what changed.

perspectives.relation: ranked by tier, then by dependents

perspectives.title: Structure
perspectives.question: What contains what, and who holds a role there?

perspectives.title: Flow
perspectives.question: How does it happen, step by step?

perspectives.title: Data
perspectives.question: What is stored and what refers to what?
